auth.err.account-exists: This number is already registered. Sign in with your password, or reset it.
auth.err.current-password-wrong: Enter your current password — or sign in with a one-time code first to reset it.
auth.err.device-key: This device's sign-in key did not work. Refresh the page and try again.
auth.err.invalid-phone: Enter a Nigerian mobile number, e.g. 08031234567.
auth.err.password-login-unavailable: Password sign-in is not available for this number. Sign in with a one-time code, then set a password on your profile. If you deleted your account, signing in this way restores it.
auth.err.password-too-long: That password is too long (200 characters max).
auth.err.too-many-passwords: Too many wrong passwords. Wait an hour, or sign in with a one-time code instead.
auth.err.wrong-password: Wrong password. Forgot it? Sign in with a one-time code to reset it.
